description: C++23 campaign runtime and SDL3/Vulkan client with durable Player17 saves, research, fleet orders, shipyard, construction and observer-safe orbital workspaces. Native local fleets follow canonical transit; connected exits preserve knowledge gates and orbital clearance. Planet imagery and mouse navigation use bounded caches. No Godot or .NET runtime is required. Detailed system graphics, orbital structures, colony/diplomacy screens and audio remain under development. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
